(Japanese: '''秋葉原博士''' ''Chōta'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the worldwide [[banned episodes|banned episode]] [[AG101 (unaired)]].

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived on [[Jojo Island]] and helped Chōta, a local Trainer, battle several {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Whiscash}} who were causing tremors across [[Jojo Island]].
